name: BC Provincial Nominee Program (Skills Immigration)
name_fr: Programme des candidats des provinces de la Colombie-Britannique
description: Skilled-worker streams of the BC Provincial Nominee Program (Skills Immigration) and whether they run through Express Entry (an Express Entry-aligned nomination adds 600 CRS points).

attributes.legal_status: in force on the access date (provincial programme under a federal–provincial agreement)

skilled_worker_streams.summary: Job offer in a TEER 0–3 occupation; WelcomeBC lists at least two years' full-time-equivalent experience

Indeterminate full-time job offer in an eligible TEER 0–2 health occupation from a B.C. public health authority; physicians, nurse practitioners and midwives with health-authority support also eligible; direct application without registration
Current health-authority employees in eligible cleaning or security roles in rural/remote areas; no Express Entry option

attributes.express_entry_aligned: Yes — 'Express Entry BC' option for the Skilled Worker and Health Authority streams (candidate must already be in the federal pool)
attributes.notes: Programme guide effective 10 June 2026. In 2025 the Health Authority stream was 27% and Skilled Worker 22% of Skills Immigration nominations (BC PNP statistical report 2025).
attributes.status_dependency: Eligibility depends on occupation (NOC/TEER), job offer, language scores and existing ties to the province — all unknown (USER-PROFILE.md; OPEN-QUESTIONS.md items 2, 4, 7).

sources.title: BC PNP Skills Immigration Program Guide (effective 10 June 2026)

verification.notes: Read through search-engine extracts of the provincial programme's official pages, not fetched in full.

limitations: Stream rules change several times a year and intake is often by invitation only; read the provincial guide in force before applying.
